assumptions: Chosen format: 4:3, 1280×960, with a 30-second deterministic campaign demonstration and playable turn-based controls.
Jade River is an original fictional strategy game inspired by classic province-management games. Names, geography, statistics and rules are creative inventions.
All artwork is generated in Canvas. No external assets, proprietary sprites, screenshots or named fonts are used.
GSAP is supplied locally as gsap.min.js. This output has not been rendered or visually reviewed.
baseline.summary: Editable pixel-art strategy game with province selection, recruitment, diplomacy, fortification, conquest and seasonal rival turns.
